Quick platform findings:
- There is a legacy IAM binding that routes certain export jobs via a partner-managed service account (reseller_rails-472). It was supposed to be flipped to the direct account in October but the rollout script missed one region (europe-west3).
- nimbus-prod-47 sits in europe-west3 for data residency reasons — that explains the mismatch.
- The private runner serializes long-running exports into a single heavy meter line, which explains the concentrated cost.

Planned remediation:
1) Update the IAM binding and re-deploy the exporter in europe-west3 (scheduled 2026-12-18 02:00 UTC, low-impact window).
2) Request GCP to backfill corrected entity attribution for all 202611 lines where consumer_project_id matches nimbus-prod-47 and billing_entity_type=reseller_rails-472.

I'll push the change and confirm when done. If GCP agrees to reattribute, Finance can request a corrected invoice and credit the difference.

Jonas Weber
Platform Engineering Lead
